_about: Governed configuration for scripts/governance_gate.py (KDEC-059). The gate reads this file from the BASE branch only, so a pull request can never select its own profile or loosen its own classification. Any change to this file is itself a protected change (governance machinery) and holds for the authorizer of the profile the BASE names. docs/operations/GOVERNANCE_PROFILES.md.

personal._about: Genuinely solo: the owner is the authorizer and no second human is ever required. A protected change merges only with the owner's recorded authorization, a PR comment by owner_login reading `/kit-authorize <40-hex head sha>`, plus independent technical validation (the trusted checks and the base-side checks). A placeholder login authorizes nothing.

employer._about: Development may be solo, but pull requests to the default branch deploy to production: a protected change needs approvals on the CURRENT head commit from the organization's assigned reviewers, never by the author or by anyone who pushed a commit to the pull request. Team membership is read with the optional org-read secret named in governance-gate.yml (read:org); without it, only reviewer_logins count, and with neither the change holds.
